vv60:1.1: Susukkakhandhaṃ abhiruyha nāgaṃ ākācinaṃ dantiṃ baliṃ mahājavaṃ āruyha gajavaraṃ sukappitaṃ idhāgamā vehāsayam antalikkhe. || ||
vv60:2.1: Nāgassa dantesu duvesu nimmitā acchodikā paduminiyo suphullā padumesu ca turiyagaṇā pavajjare imā ca naccanti manoharāyo. || ||
vv60:3.1: Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo manussabhūto kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv60:4.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv60:5.1: Aṭṭh' eva muttapupphāni Kassapassa mahesino thūpasmiṃ abhiropesiṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi.
